# Annemarie Andersen - Easy Language and Plain Language

> Independent language specialist for Easy Language, Plain Language and clear communication for public bodies, organizations and agencies. Freelance since 2018. Additional services include language quality assurance, editing, translation and copywriting.

This is the English version of the site. German original: https://annemarie-andersen.de/llms.txt

## Services

- Easy Language: rewriting existing texts or creating new German texts for websites, forms, brochures and public information. Any target-group or review-group testing is arranged by the client.
- Plain Language: revision and new writing for German factual texts under DIN 8581-1, including customer information, forms, administrative texts, health communication and internal guidelines.
- Language support for agencies: Easy Language, Plain Language, final editing, quality assurance of client and AI drafts, editing and German-English translation for client projects.
- Clear Administrative Language: rewriting German notices, forms and contract language in clearer terms. Legal review remains the responsibility of the competent legal professional.
- AI Quality Assurance and Post-Editing: checking AI-generated texts for factual errors, source issues, stylistic inconsistencies and compliance-related risks.
- Editing and Translation: proofreading, stylistic editing and specialist German-English translation.
- Copywriting: impact reports, annual reports, corporate reports, grant applications and concepts.
- Website accessibility analysis: WCAG-oriented review of representative page types, with a written report, prioritized findings and recommendations for technical implementation. No certificate of conformance or legal advice.
